project_type: EaseMyOffice CRM — TanStack Start + React 19 SPA (file-based routes), Supabase (Postgres + Deno edge functions) backend, deployed on Cloudflare Workers
build_system: Bun (bun.lock). Scripts in package.json: dev=vite dev, build=vite build, test=vitest run, lint=eslint. Node toolchain lives at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin — export it to PATH before npx tsc, otherwise npx dies silently.
test_framework: Vitest unit tests as src/lib/*.test.ts next to source (131 tests pass today across 10 files). Playwright e2e in e2e/ (separate run). Pure logic (maths, rules, scoring) MUST be extracted into a src/lib/*.ts module and unit-tested — this is the established pattern (booking-math.ts, payroll.ts, attendance-rules.ts, report-metrics.ts).
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" && bun install --frozen-lockfile && npx tsc --noEmit && bun run build
verification_instructions: Baseline confirmed green at session start: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` = 131 passed / 10 files, `bun run build` = ok in ~12s emitting dist/server. Full gate before any push: (1) export node PATH, (2) bun install --frozen-lockfile, (3) npx tsc --noEmit clean, (4) bun run test all green, (5) bun run build succeeds. Adding/removing a route file regenerates src/routeTree.gen.ts during build — commit the regenerated file. New files must be prettier-clean (npx prettier --write <file>); touched existing files must gain no NEW eslint errors (repo carries thousands of pre-existing prettier errors so `bun run lint` fails repo-wide — compare per-file problem counts, do not run repo-wide lint as a gate).
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/routeTree.gen.ts is auto-generated by `bun run build` (and the vite dev server) from the files under src/routes. Never hand-edit it; add/remove route files then rebuild and commit the regenerated tree.
environment_constraints: NO Supabase credentials in the sandbox: cannot run SQL, cannot touch live data, cannot regenerate src/integrations/supabase/types.ts (that needs `supabase gen types` with project creds). Consequence: new B2B tables will NOT appear in the generated types.ts. Follow the EXISTING escape-hatch pattern from src/lib/hrms.ts — a `hrmsDb()`-style helper that casts `supabase as any` plus hand-written row types in a dedicated lib module (e.g. src/lib/b2b.ts exporting `b2bDb()` + types). Migrations are authored as new timestamp-prefixed .sql files but are APPLIED BY THE OWNER manually (full SQL pasted in chat); keep every migration idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS, ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS). The sandbox cannot run a dev server (long-running processes refused) so UI is validated via typecheck+build, not visually. /tmp is not writable — use /projects/sandbox for scratch. `diff` is not installed.
contribution_requirements: ADDITIVE ONLY — never edit or delete existing migrations, tables, or data. Existing Sales / Renewals / Documentation / Accounts / HRMS flows must keep working unchanged. Reuse the existing design system (shadcn/ui primitives in src/components/ui, Card/Table/Tabs/Badge/Select/Dialog), the existing auth (useAuth, AppRole, hasRole, isAdmin), route guards (guardRoles in src/lib/route-guard.ts), toasts via sonner, and the existing permission architecture — do NOT invent a new authz system. Permissions MUST be enforced server-side via Supabase RLS, not just hidden in the frontend. Payroll/salary is strictly owner-only for employees (mirror the HRMS salary RLS). The owner expects a 'classy' iOS-26 glassy look (see bookings.tsx Fresh/Renewal tabs and src/components/hrms/glass-tabs.tsx).
key_patterns: ROLES: app_role is a Postgres ENUM ('admin','sales','documentation','accounts','renewals','bd'); adding B2B needs `ALTER TYPE public.app_role ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'b2b'` in its OWN migration committed/applied BEFORE any migration or policy references the value (Postgres forbids using a new enum value in the same transaction that adds it). Also add 'b2b' to AppRole in src/lib/auth.tsx and to ROLE_OPTIONS in src/routes/_authenticated/admin/users.tsx (currently ["sales","bd","documentation","accounts","renewals","admin"]). RLS HELPERS already exist in the DB: public.is_admin(auth.uid()) and public.has_role(auth.uid(),'<role>') (SECURITY DEFINER). Standard table RLS pattern (see 20260516000005_hrms_phase1.sql): ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; a SELECT policy `USING (public.is_admin(auth.uid()) OR assigned_to = auth.uid())` and a write policy gated on is_admin or ownership. Column-level secrets (salary, PAN) go in a SEPARATE admin-only table because Postgres RLS is row-level not column-level. NAV: src/components/app-shell.tsx has NAV + ADMIN_NAV arrays of {to,label,icon,roles?}; visibleFor() filters by role (admin sees all); MobileTabBar mirrors it. CSV PARSING: a robust parseCSV + synonym auto-map + preview flow already exists INLINE in src/routes/_authenticated/leads/import.tsx (copy/adapt it; csv.ts only has export helpers). AUDIT: src/lib/audit.ts logAudit() is fire-and-forget into audit_log (migration 20260516000003); extend AuditEntity for B2B entities. GLOBAL SEARCH: src/lib/global-search-context.tsx + src/components/global-search.tsx. CRM constants (STAGES/SOURCES/SERVICES/labelFor/initials) in src/lib/crm.ts — add a parallel src/lib/b2b.ts for B2B stages/statuses/sources rather than polluting crm.ts.
relevant_files: src/routes/_authenticated/leads/import.tsx (CSV parse + mapping + preview — reuse for B2B import)
src/lib/report-metrics.ts (+test), report-queries.ts, report-period.ts, analytics.ts (analytics maths pattern)
src/lib/hrms.ts (hrmsDb() escape-hatch + hand-written row types — THE pattern for B2B tables)
src/lib/payroll.ts (+payroll.test.ts), attendance-rules.ts (+test), attendance-client.ts, attendance-queries.ts (HRMS to EXTEND for B2B employees)
src/components/hrms/glass-tabs.tsx, glass-tab-styles.ts (glassy tab styling to reuse)
src/lib/csv.ts (export helpers), src/lib/booking-math.ts (money math single source of truth)
directory_structure: src/routes/_authenticated/ holds file-based routes (nested folders -> nested paths); _authenticated.tsx is the auth layer, hrms.tsx is an admin-guarded layout with hrms/* child tabs. src/components/ui = shadcn primitives; src/components/{dashboard,hrms,bookings,renewals,clients} = feature components. src/lib = shared logic + pure/tested modules + supabase client cast helpers. supabase/migrations = timestamp-prefixed SQL (additive). supabase/functions = Deno edge functions (service-role, the only server-side writers given Cloudflare does not pass secrets to TanStack server fns). src/integrations/supabase/{client.ts,types.ts} — types.ts is generated and does NOT contain HRMS/B2B tables.
